## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}
getwd()
install.packages("here")  # only once
library(here)
biodiversity <- read.csv(here("data", "BIO.csv"))
str(biodiversity)
summary(biodiversity)
```

### This semester I plan to conduct a project using the ADAPT data set, examining AI-human substitution beliefs and AI idealizing beliefs. I am interested in what factors predict these beliefs, and how they change over time. I will use longitudinal data to assess how T1 AI beliefs develop at T2, and how they might relate to peoples' experiences of high-quality interactions with others.
